Container.Name: MultiDash
Container.Overview:
MultiDash is a lightweight, self-hosted dashboard for monitoring multiple Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin media servers in a unified interface.
**Note:** The default repository is 'ghcr.io/tophicles/dash'. Ensure this package is set to PUBLIC in GitHub Package settings, otherwise unRAID will fail to pull it. Alternatively, build locally.
